name: simulate_monthly_plan
description: Calculate a next-month what-if WITHOUT saving changes. First read_monthly_plan, then choose its sourceKey values. Each newAmount must be 0..baseline, at most two decimals. Loans and credit-card bills cannot be reduced. Other reductions are conditional possibilities, not verified permission to defer. Never apply changes, use portfolio value as cash, invent user flexibility, or derive/disclose income. When user protects SIPs or another item, omit those sources from adjustments.
